name: Docswrite Public API
description: Public REST API for publishing Google Docs to WordPress and other CMS platforms. Authenticate with an org API key (Authorization: Bearer dw_live_…; one key for every connection of the organization) or a per-site API token (x-access-token). Org-key responses carry RateLimit-Limit / RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset headers. See /auth.md.
